ayahs.ar: اِنَّا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوۡحًا اِلٰي قَوۡمِهٖ٘ اَنۡ اَنۡذِرۡ قَوۡمَكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Innaaa arsalnaa Noohan ilaa qawmihee an anzir qawmaka min qabli any yaatiyahum 'azaabun aleem
ayahs.en: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اِنِّيۡ لَكُمۡ نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala yaa qawmi innee lakum nazeerum mubeen
ayahs.en: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner,

ayahs.ar: اَنِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَاتَّقُوۡهُ وَاَطِيۡعُوۡنِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Ani'udul laaha watta qoohu wa atee'oon
ayahs.en: [Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me.

ayahs.ar: يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ ذُنُوۡبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرۡكُمۡ اِلٰ٘ي اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّيؕ اِنَّ اَجَلَ اللّٰهِ اِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُۘ لَوۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yaghfir lakum min zunoobikum wa yu'akhkhirkum ilaaa ajalim musammaa; innaa ajalal laahi izaa jaaa'a laa yu'akhkhar; law kuntum ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew.' "

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّيۡ دَعَوۡتُ قَوۡمِيۡ لَيۡلًا وَّنَهَارًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala rabbi innee da'awtu qawmee lailanw wa naharaa
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.

ayahs.ar: فَلَمۡ يَزِدۡهُمۡ دُعَآءِيۡ٘ اِلَّا فِرَارًا
ayahs.tl: Falam yazid hum du'aaa 'eee illaa firaaraa
ayahs.en: But my invitation increased them not except in flight.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنِّيۡ كُلَّمَا دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ لِتَغۡفِرَ لَهُمۡ جَعَلُوۡ٘ا اَصَابِعَهُمۡ فِيۡ٘ اٰذَانِهِمۡ وَاسۡتَغۡشَوۡا ثِيَابَهُمۡ وَاَصَرُّوۡا وَاسۡتَكۡبَرُوا اسۡتِكۡبَارًاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa inee kullamaa da'awtuhum litaghfira lahum ja'alooo asaabi'ahum fee aazaanihim wastaghshaw siyaabahum wa asaarroo wastakbarus tikbaaraa
ayahs.en: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اِنِّيۡ دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ جِهَارًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Summa innee da'aw tuhum jihaara
ayahs.en: Then I invited them publicly.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَعۡلَنۡتُ لَهُمۡ وَاَسۡرَرۡتُ لَهُمۡ اِسۡرَارًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Summaa inneee a'lantu lahum wa asrartu lahum israaraa
ayahs.en: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly

ayahs.ar: فَقُلۡتُ اسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡࣞ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ غَفَّارًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Faqultus taghfiroo Rabakam innahoo kaana Ghaffaaraa
ayahs.en: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.

ayahs.ar: يُّرۡسِلِ السَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّدۡرَارًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Yursilis samaaa'a 'alaikum midraaraa
ayahs.en: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers

ayahs.ar: وَّيُمۡدِدۡكُمۡ بِاَمۡوَالٍ وَّبَنِيۡنَ وَيَجۡعَلۡ لَّكُمۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّيَجۡعَلۡ لَّكُمۡ اَنۡهٰرًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa yumdidkum bi am waalinw wa baneena wa yaj'al lakum Jannaatinw wa yaj'al lakum anhaaraa
ayahs.en: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.

ayahs.ar: مَا لَكُمۡ لَا تَرۡجُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِ وَقَارًاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Maa lakum laa tarjoona lillaahi waqaaraa
ayahs.en: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur

ayahs.ar: وَقَدۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ اَطۡوَارًا
ayahs.tl: Wa qad khalaqakum at waaraa
ayahs.en: While He has created you in stages?

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَوۡا كَيۡفَ خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ سَبۡعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ طِبَاقًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Alam taraw kaifa khalaqal laahu sab'a samaawaatin tibaaqaa
ayahs.en: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers

ayahs.ar: وَّجَعَلَ الۡقَمَرَ فِيۡهِنَّ نُوۡرًا وَّجَعَلَ الشَّمۡسَ سِرَاجًا
ayahs.tl: Wa ja'alal qamara feehinna nooranw wa ja'alash shamsa siraajaa
ayahs.en: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?

ayahs.ar: وَاللّٰهُ اَنۭۡ بَتَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَرۡضِ نَبَاتًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallaahu ambatakum minal ardi nabaataa
ayahs.en: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ يُعِيۡدُكُمۡ فِيۡهَا وَيُخۡرِجُكُمۡ اِخۡرَاجًا
ayahs.tl: Summa yu'eedukum feehaa wa ukhrijukum ikhraajaa
ayahs.en: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.

ayahs.ar: وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ بِسَاطًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallaahu ja'ala lakumul arda bisaataa
ayahs.en: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse

ayahs.ar: لِّتَسۡلُكُوۡا مِنۡهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Litaslukoo minhaa subulan fijaajaa
ayahs.en: That you may follow therein roads of passage.' "

ayahs.ar: قَالَ نُوۡحٌ رَّبِّ اِنَّهُمۡ عَصَوۡنِيۡ وَاتَّبَعُوۡا مَنۡ لَّمۡ يَزِدۡهُ مَالُهٗ وَوَلَدُهٗ٘ اِلَّا خَسَارًاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala Noohur Robbi innahum 'asawnee wattaba'oo mal lam yazid hu maaluhoo wa waladuhooo illaa khasaara
ayahs.en: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.

ayahs.ar: وَمَكَرُوۡا مَكۡرًا كُبَّارًاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa makaroo makran kubbaaraa
ayahs.en: And they conspired an immense conspiracy.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡا لَا تَذَرُنَّ اٰلِهَتَكُمۡ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَّلَا سُوَاعًا ࣢ۙ وَّلَا يَغُوۡثَ وَيَعُوۡقَ وَنَسۡرًاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaaloo laa tazarunna aalihatakum wa laa tazarunna Waddanw wa laa Suwaa'anw wa laa Yaghoosa wa Ya'ooqa wa Nasraa
ayahs.en: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.

ayahs.ar: وَقَدۡ اَضَلُّوۡا كَثِيۡرًا ࣢ۚ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ اِلَّا ضَلٰلًا
ayahs.tl: Wa qad adalloo kasee ranw wa laa tazidiz zaalimeena illaa dalaalaa
ayahs.en: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."

ayahs.ar: مِمَّا خَطِيۡٓـٰٔتِهِمۡ اُغۡرِقُوۡا فَاُدۡخِلُوۡا نَارًا ࣢ۙ فَلَمۡ يَجِدُوۡا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَنۡصَارًا
ayahs.tl: Mimmaa khateee' aatihim ughriqoo fa udkhiloo Naaran falam yajidoo lahum min doonil laahi ansaaraa
ayahs.en: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ نُوۡحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرۡ عَلَي الۡاَرۡضِ مِنَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ دَيَّارًا
ayahs.tl: Wa qaala Noohur Rabbi laa tazar 'alal ardi minal kaafireena daiyaaraa
ayahs.en: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّكَ اِنۡ تَذَرۡهُمۡ يُضِلُّوۡا عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
ayahs.tl: Innaka in tazarhum yudil loo 'ibaadaka wa laa yalidooo illaa faajiran kaffaaraa
ayahs.en: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.

ayahs.ar: رَبِّ اغۡفِرۡ لِيۡ وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنۡ دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنًا وَّلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ وَالۡمُؤۡمِنٰتِؕ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ اِلَّا تَبَارًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Rabbigh fir lee wa liwaa lidaiya wa liman dakhala baitiya mu'minanw wa lil mu'mineena wal mu'minaati wa laa tazidiz zaalimeena illaa tabaaraa
ayahs.en: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
